profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: I currently work at Microsoft on the Azure Data Governance team.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Software Engineer Intern on the Azure Data team. Developed a redesigned pipeline prototype to help ensure GDPR compliance across Azure.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: I developed and deployed a distributed project change control dashboard, an internal tool used by hundreds of project teams to track status during development and deployment phases. To do this, I created and maintained Oracle Databases on the back-end. I utilized Spring Boot, Jersey, and Maven in the Java 8 mid-tier. To connect to the Angular 5 front-end, I set up a REST API that accepted calls from the front end and transferred data over in a JSON format. After each stage of development, I used Jenkins to deploy the project to internal servers. During the development process, my team utilized an Agile development format with daily stand-up meetings to increase efficiency.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: I developed and maintained engineering websites for professors and academic departments inside the case.edu domain. To teach users how to update their own sites, I organized and led training sessions on Drupal software, a content management program, and created training manuals and documentation for maintaining Drupal sites.

positions.title: Website Development Intern
positions.description: I developed new features for Remote Management Portal (RMP), a portal used by Intwine customers to view and control their IoT devices. These features included historical data tracking and data graphing. In addition, I fixed existing bugs in the RMP and provided feedback on the development of the 4G Gateway Router.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Redesigned the Krawler Robot to simulate lunar rover on a lunar surface by 3D printing and laser cutting components for stronger servo axle support and camera mounts. Added dual 180 degree cameras to provide a seamless virtual reality user experience via Oculus Rift headset.

certifications.name: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
certifications.title: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science

honors.title: Dean’s High Honors List
honors.description: I received the prestigious Dean's High Honors award as my Spring 2018 GPA was above a 3.75/4.00.
honors.issuer: Issued by Case Western Reserve University · May 2018

volunteerExperiences.description: Traveled with a group of doctors and volunteers around Singapore to provide free health care to underpaid  foreign workers. The mission provided care for 400 workers each month.
Assisted with the construction of schools and homes in rural Cambodia.

projects.title: SMSTaxi
projects.description: We Developed a system to order Lyft rides via SMS messaging using Lyft and Twilio APIs. I led implementation of the Twilio API and the development of the website's front end.

projects.title: Java Interpreter
projects.description: We wrote an interpreter for Java code in Scheme that handled static/dynamic variables, static/dynamic/abstract methods, and classes with inheritance. We also built in support for most built in Java functions including conditionals, loops, try-catch, and other statements.

organizations.name: HackCWRU
organizations.description: I am responsible for ensuring HackCWRU 2019 runs without any problems. This includes tasks that range from coordinating busses to bring in students from other schools to ordering food to picking prizes for the event.
